_comment: De-dup ledger for the Sentry New-Error Spike Alert schedule (skills/sentry-spike-alert.md). Seeded 2026-08-07 from the investigation that motivated the schedule.

SUPERSET-PYTHON-12EZ.note: Chronic since 2026-04-27 — QueryObjectValidationError 'list object has no element 0', a customer virtual-dataset Jinja template rendering error (ChartDataRestApi.data). ~115k events/7d, 0 users, handled. Dominant volume driver, not a new spike. Only re-alert if >=3x this peak.

SUPERSET-PYTHON-158W.note: fsspec ImportError in SqlLabRestApi.execute_sql_query, workspace 73cc29dd (ai-tutor Athena/S3 reads). New 2026-08-03, escalating, 5 users. Code/dependency-shaped.

SUPERSET-PYTHON-15GE.note: OperationalError: MySQLdb can't connect (errno 2002/115), culprit ChartDataRestApi.data / load_chart_data_into_cache. Customer-owned DB unreachable from Preset — classic customer-DB config infra-noise per skills/sentry-error-burndown.md skip-list. 0 users throughout. Crossed New-lens threshold as of 2026-08-22 (197>=100, firstSeen<=72h then) but held per project_elizabeth_ooo_2026_08_18 (names this exact schedule as an example of routine pings to hold during her 2026-08-18-to-~08-25 OOO window) — not urgent/blocking. Not added to `alerted` since no DM was sent. Re-checked 2026-08-24, now also surfaced via the is:escalating lens (still well under the 500/24h escalating threshold): count=274 (was 197 on 08-23, +77 over ~1-2 days — steady trickle, not a sharp jump), userCount=0 still, lastSeen 2026-08-24T13:20Z (still firing, not dormant). Note: latest sampled event this run shows a different unreachable host ('laughing-snyder...plesk.page') than the 08-22/08-23 sample (an Alibaba RDS host) — this Sentry issue appears to group multiple distinct customers' MySQL-unreachable events under one exception-type/culprit fingerprint rather than being one customer's outage; every sample seen so far is still customer-DB-config-shaped, still 0 users. firstSeen 2026-08-20 is now >72h old so the New-lens path no longer applies — the only live threshold path is the 500/24h escalating bar, not yet crossed. Elizabeth still OOO (back ~08-25, i.e. tomorrow). Continuing to hold, no change. Re-evaluate on next run: DM once Elizabeth is back, if it starts affecting users (userCount>0), or if it crosses the 500/24h escalating bar.

2026-08-14-search-index-stale.note: CORRECTED 2026-08-14 PM (in-thread with Elizabeth, same day): not a stuck search index. Org preset-inc has been over its Sentry error-event quota since 2026-08-05T20:54 UTC — stats_v2 split by outcome shows accepted/category=error = 0 every day 08-06 through 08-14 (was 76,102 on 08-04), while client_discard/rate_limited climbed instead (reasons: error_usage_exceeded, ratelimit_backoff). lastSeen=2026-08-05 on every issue is therefore correct, not stale — nothing new has actually landed. The 08-12->08-13 '2.42x org-wide jump' (46,264->112,051) re-attributed to project superset-python alone, and it's a spike in rejected (ratelimit_backoff) volume, not accepted errors — not a real dashboard doubling. /api/0/subscriptions/preset-inc/ 404s on this token — no quota/reset visibility without org-owner billing access. DMed + corrected same thread (D0BBR2PPFQ9, ts=1786716266.840669); Elizabeth engaged live but thread has no billing-side resolution yet.
2026-08-14-search-index-stale.status: RECOVERED 2026-08-19, still ramping 2026-08-20 — org-wide volume-delta today: current 24h=21681 vs prior 24h=7705 (2.81x, nominally over the 1.5x org-wide-jump threshold). Checked top contributors before deciding whether this is news: SUPERSET-PYTHON-12EZ (acknowledged_baseline) is 13171/24h, ~61% of the total — cross-checked against its 7d-scoped count (18205/7d, i.e. ~2600/day average over the week including the near-zero days) and its historical peak_events_7d baseline (115244, i.e. ~16463/day pre-outage) — today's 24h rate is close to but still under that historical daily average, so this reads as 'still climbing back to normal,' not a re-escalation (not >=3x peak, no re-alert trigger). The rest of the org-wide total is spread across other pre-existing chronic issues that also resumed after the quota outage (SUPERSET-PYTHON-YE9 firstSeen 2025-12-11, MANAGER-PYTHON-40E firstSeen 2026-07-21, websocket/502/SSL/timeout infra-noise cluster A9F/VVE/XVB/YYS/YFN/VVF/VVG/A2F/F2/ZVK/13JV) — none newly created, none tagged is:escalating by Sentry, none individually crossing the New (>=100 events, firstSeen<=72h) or Escalating (>=500 events/24h) thresholds (max in either lens was 27 events, on unrelated small new issues from 08-19/08-20). Conclusion: this is the same 08-19 recovery event continuing to ramp toward steady-state, not new information — did NOT re-DM. Elizabeth still OOO per project_elizabeth_ooo_2026_08_18 (routine pings on hold, back ~08-25); the SUPERSET-PYTHON-12EZ fix is still the open PR apache/superset#43081 (sc-117145). Re-alert if: accepted volume drops back toward 0 (recovery reverses), any issue starts showing is:escalating with >=500 events/24h now that real signal is flowing, or 12EZ's 24h rate pushes past its ~16463/day historical average by a wide margin (would suggest genuine re-escalation, not just recovery ramp). UPDATE 2026-08-24: org-wide volume-delta today is 13482 vs prior 4645 (2.90x, still nominally over 1.5x), but the picture has flipped from 'ramping back up' to 'settled into steady-state infra-noise' — SUPERSET-PYTHON-12EZ has gone fully quiet (lastSeen 2026-08-20T22:29Z, zero events in the trailing 24h per both the issue lookup and a 24h-scoped org search) and is no longer a contributor at all. The current 24h top-15 by freq is entirely the same known chronic cluster (VVE, A9F, VVF, VVG, BS3, 96T, A2F, F2, 13JV, YE9, MANAGER-PYTHON-1G5) plus report-execution noise (15FR, ZR1) — same categories as 08-20, still lastSeen 08-24 (i.e. genuinely active, not stale), none individually crossing New/Escalating thresholds. Conclusion unchanged: not new information, did NOT re-DM. Re-alert conditions unchanged (see above), now effectively simplified since 12EZ is quiet: watch for any single chronic issue in the cluster crossing 500 events/24h on its own, or a genuinely new (non-cluster) issue driving the delta.
